Marco D: Hey all  Just unboxed my onboarding gear and the monitor looks great but there's no USB-C power/data cable in the box. Dock powers up but laptop says no display detected. Any chance the cable was left out? Opening ticket INC-4456.

Nina (IT): Welcome Marco! Sorry about that. Can you confirm the monitor model number (on the back) and whether the dock is a DynaDockX? If it's a missing cable we can courier one same-day.

Marco D: Model says 'Aurora32-144' and dock label is 'DynaDockX v2'. I tried the spare USB-C from my old laptop and still no signal. The Macbook's USB-C port shows power but the monitor stays black.

Nina (IT): Hmm. Two possibilities: (1) bad cable (2) dock USB-C port not configured for DP alt-mode. Can you try connecting the Macbook directly to the monitor with a different cable? If still nothing, I'll request an RMA for the monitor.

Marco D: Tried direct HDMI via the dock's HDMI out (with adapter) 914 still no image. Also noticing the monitor's on-screen menu reports input "USB-C" only and firmware ver 1.02.

asset-bot: Asset INC-4456 created; asset-tag pending assignment.

Nina (IT): Thanks for the details. I'm swapping this to 'hardware-diagnostic' status and scheduling a pick-up for the monitor tomorrow between 10-1. I'll send a courier with a USB-C 100W cable and a test adapter so we can rule out docking vs monitor.

People Ops: Welcome @Marco D :wave: If pickup needs a signature, we can use the personal address you provided on the form. LMK if you'd prefer office drop-off instead.

Marco D: Office drop-off is fine if there's a local Redwood hub; otherwise home address is ok. Also: small request - could you pre-install the VPN client on the replacement laptop image? Saves me from juggling installs during my first week.

Nina (IT): Noted. We'll image the replacement with SecureConnect and Okta SSO ahead of shipping. I'll attach tracking once the courier is scheduled. Marking INC-4456 for follow-up until confirmed. :thumbsup:

Marco D: Awesome, appreciate the fast help. See you on the 1:1 in a bit!
